annotations.workers/message: rollback to pinned live version (unfancy recovery, source 6dcdd25)

pre_rollback_assert.assert: latest deployment id === pinned_live_deployment_id AND its version_id === pinned_live_version_id; otherwise the pin is stale -> regenerate payloads from a fresh read-only snapshot, never apply blindly.

caveats: Rollback reverts to the pre-DO KV-state consumer and REMOVES the OAUTH_STATE binding and the OAuthState class: the atomic single-use guarantee is lost.
Do NOT delete/redeploy the OAuthState class afterwards without a separate reviewed removal migration; rollback must be followed by a fresh authorized /setup run.
